C001.reason: This is v1 Entity processing. The v1 schema still uses string entity_id, so decoded.EntityId returns string. No change needed for v1 behavior.

C002.reason: This is v2 Entity processing. The v2 schema now uses bytes entity_id, so decoded.EntityId returns ByteString. Must UTF-8 decode to string for the observation field while preserving the exact entity_id key with string value.

C003.reason: This constructs a v1 Entity for the standalone sample. v1 schema still uses string entity_id, so EntityId = "cs_202" remains correct as string literal.

C004.reason: This constructs a v2 Entity for the standalone sample. v2 schema now uses bytes entity_id, so EntityId must be assigned a ByteString. Preserve the same logical identifier "cs_202" by UTF-8 encoding the string literal to ByteString.

rationale: Only v2 Entity.entity_id changes from string to bytes. For observations, the decoded ByteString must be UTF-8 decoded to string (ByteString.ToStringUtf8()) to preserve the entity_id observation key with string value. For construction, the string literal must be UTF-8 encoded to ByteString (ByteString.CopyFromUtf8()). v1 paths remain unchanged since v1 schema still uses string. The standalone sample identifier "cs_202" is preserved in both versions. All three subscribers independently decode both schema versions via ProcessEntity.
assumptions: Generated C# bindings for v2 Entity.EntityId now return Google.Protobuf.ByteString
ByteString.ToStringUtf8() performs UTF-8 decoding matching the intended behavior
ByteString.CopyFromUtf8(string) performs UTF-8 encoding matching the intended behavior
The observation contract requires entity_id key with string value (not base64 or raw bytes)
No changes to v1 schema or generated bindings
Pub/sub delivery payload remains base64-encoded protobuf bytes as before
